warning: DSM-DTM is a signed provider-product difference, not object height. Low residual does not exclude rock; high residual does not identify rock or vegetation.

vertical_reference.units: metres, as established by retained source/terrain manifests
vertical_reference.datum: ODN in existing terrain provenance; neither TIFF explicitly encodes a vertical CRS/unit
vertical_reference.compatibility: Same provider delivery/acquisition and identical grids. No vertical transformation. Absolute datum independently unspecified in downloaded TIFF metadata; difference is relative to these paired products.
vertical_reference.classification: Provider DTM/DSM labels; exact rocky-ground filtering/interpolation rules unavailable. No object-height interpretation.

processing.subtraction: float64 DSM minus DTM then float32 output; signed values retained; no smoothing/resampling
processing.nodata: NaN if either source invalid; both source masks contain zero invalid cells
processing.window_edges: Only complete square windows; undefined boundary diagnostics are NaN. Even windows centre 0.5m east/south of labelled cell.
processing.slope: arctan(hypot(dDTM/dx,dDTM/dy)), NumPy 1m gradient; second-order one-sided outer edge
processing.roughness: DTM minus 5x5 local mean, not slope-confounded elevation standard deviation; local relief=max-min over 5x5
processing.renderer_display: viridis(clip(log(1+max(residual,0))/log(11),0,1)); fixed 0–10m log stretch; 3000x3000 1m RGB, north at row zero; negatives visible only in signed offline view

lab010_comparison.method: Mean signed 1m difference in exact 10x10m cells; Pearson correlation with unaltered reflectance bands, no semantic classification
lab010_comparison.limitation: 10m colour is too coarse to identify single-cell or several-metre structures; different acquisition dates and illumination confound correlation.

extremes_assessment: Both extremes are interior valid paired source cells, not AOI/nodata/resampling edges. Neighbourhoods retained for review. Product interpolation/classification or genuine surface variation cannot be distinguished without return-level evidence; no extremes discarded.

semantics.rendered: Offline figures and reversible quantitative Unreal display
semantics.inferred: No semantic classes; cautious analytical interpretation only
